items.name: Roasted Brussels sprouts
items.preparation: halved/whole, oven-roasted until charred and glazed

items.name: Cooking oil (olive oil coating on sprouts)
items.preparation: absorbed/coated during roasting, implied by glossy surface

scale_cues: White square dinner plate (assumed ~26 cm side) on a scale platform; roughly 14-16 sprout pieces each ~3-4 cm across, covering about a quarter of the plate.
assumptions: Plate is a standard ~26 cm square dinner plate
Sprouts are roasted with oil; glossy yellowish sheen suggests oil and possibly a light glaze or seasoning
About 14-16 pieces at ~8-9 g each cooked weight
No separate sauce or other items present
Roasted Brussels sprouts taken at ~43 kcal and 3.4 g protein per 100 g excluding oil
